description: The answer of the safety reviewer (review/policy.md, "Answer").

brief.description: One line for each capability in feature.json, for the member.

capability.description: A capability of feature.json, named exactly as there (for example "vars_read").

text.description: What the feature does with it, in plain words.

cleared.description: Risks that the reviewer checked and found safe.

dependencies.description:
One row for each dependency that the review read (not creator code): the powers of its
own code. The dependency ledger keeps them (plan S2 step 2), so a later feature that uses
the same code is judged by them without a new read.

name.description: The name and version of a `read` package of dependencies.json.

powers.description:
The capabilities of feature.json that its code needs (for example "direct_network");
empty when it needs none.

reaches.description: The hosts, programs, registry keys and files that its code reaches; empty when none.

feature.description: The id and version in the reviewed feature.json.

findings.description: Safety findings only, most severe first. Empty for approve.

file.description: Relative to the repository root, with "/" separators.

line.description: The first line of the problem.

power.description: The power that the code uses, for example "direct file access".

powers.description: One row for each power that the feature declares or uses.

declared.description: What feature.json declares for it ("none" when nothing).

matches.description: True when the use stays inside the declaration.

used.description: What the shipped code uses ("none" when nothing).

quality.description: Short notes for the admin, not for members or the creator; never a reason to deny.

reason.description: One or two plain sentences: why.

verdict.description: approve when there is no safety finding, else deny.

title: Verdict
